title: Assayer, by its natural name in context
situation: Decision 0018 named the judging role from a context-free cold reading of 'assayer' and 'reviewer'. That reading is the corpus's oracle for finding the single best signifier; a role in the workflow context needs a name that is natural within that context, read by someone working in it. Raised by the operator on 2026-10-10.
decision: The role that judges a cut once against fixed criteria stays named assayer, for reasons that hold within the context: to a software engineer, 'reviewer' naturally means code review against standards the reviewer supplies, the re-derived judging that keeps a workflow from converging (0006); 'assayer' carries testing work against a fixed standard, independently, without repairing it. It also leaves omp's bundled reviewer agent free for ordinary code review.
consequences: No change to the role, its agent or its model routing; only the evidence for the name is restated in context.
